command.showMenu.title: Noroshi: Show Menu
config.eventsFile.description: Events file to watch. A relative path is resolved against the workspace; an absolute path is treated as an absolute path on the remote (Pod).
config.sounds.notification.description: Sound file played when Claude is waiting for you. Empty uses the bundled WAV.
config.sounds.stop.description: Sound file played when Claude finishes. Empty uses the bundled WAV.
config.playerCommand.description: Playback command template. ${file} is replaced with a shell-quoted sound file path (do not wrap it in quotes yourself). Empty uses the OS default (afplay/paplay/PowerShell).
config.pollInterval.description: Polling interval (ms) as a safety net for missed watcher events. 0 disables it.
config.debounceMs.description: After playing an event, suppress the same event kind within this window (ms). 0 disables it.
config.entrypointFilter.description: Filter playback by the event entrypoint discriminator. Empty plays everything. Example: ["claude-vscode"] plays only VSCode extension sessions.
config.suppressWhenFocused.description: Do not play a sound while this VSCode window is focused.
config.statusBar.show.description: Show the Noroshi status in the status bar.
